recap_lines: First ask whether the case has a contract, or only a split of the work.
An appropriate contract has testable handoffs and a declared route for failure.
Phase gates and delegation buckets show whether the steps are appropriate.
Find every check, who does it, and the artifact that proves it happened.
Judge the evaluator by comparing the override rate with the audited error rate.
Then say it exactly, three ticks and one of four codes, not a vague review.
bookends.command: Give me short delegation cases, one at a time. For each, I answer four questions. Is there a contract, and is it appropriate? Are the steps appropriate? Where are the checks, and who does them? Who evaluates, and is that appropriate? I must name the exact terms, handoff condition, testable, failure routing, delegation buckets, verification cost, unsupervised pipeline, sign-off authority and overtrust. Hold back your answer until I reply, then correct me in two sentences.

beats.narration_text: A loan pipeline in three steps. The AI scores, a human verifies, a human decides. That is a partition, it only names who touches what. Contract, not partition means a delegation also states a checkable handoff and what happens on failure. So the first question about any case is, is there a contract, or only a partition? For example, a job seeker's plan says the agent finds listings and she applies. That is only a partition. A contract adds what every listing handed to her must include, and what happens when the agent finds none.

beats.narration_text: Now each row gains an input and an output. A delegation map is the written document that gives every pipeline step an owner, inputs, outputs, and a signal that it finished correctly. That signal is still missing here. Input, the listing and the full résumé. Output, a tailored résumé. Sending the application belongs to the job seeker.

beats.narration_text: Five officers review one case, in a simulated run. Their checking differs, yet all five logged reviews. Testable means a stranger can tell whether a condition was met. Under the rule, all four checks ticked, only officer three meets it. In a case, a handoff that only says reviews is not testable, so the contract is not yet appropriate. For example, the rule, send listings that fit well, is not testable. Readers disagree about fit. The rule, send listings in her city whose title matches her target title, is testable. Anyone can check each one.
